name: JournalFit Studio
purpose: Explainable journal discovery and fit decision support using manuscript evidence and local journal metadata.
positioning: Independent research-support tool. Not an official ranking, indexing, publisher, journal-quality, or acceptance-prediction system.
privacy_model: Local-first workflow with no external AI API required. Hosted users should avoid confidential manuscripts unless the deployment policy explicitly permits them.
deployment: Streamlit Community Cloud compatible with Python 3.11 or 3.12 and root requirements.txt.
